$comment: Sparse-checkout (cone mode) profiles for `aphrody-bun git profile <name>`. paths are directories (cone mode accepts directories only; top-level files are always checked out). submodules are gitlink paths initialised shallow (--depth 1) after the cone is set; entries ending in /* match every gitlink below that directory. optionalSubmodules get `update = none` in .gitmodules and are only fetched by a profile that lists them.

core.description: Tooling, factory, docs, infra: enough to run the quality gates that read tracked files only.

rust-workspace.description: Cargo workspace members and the path dependencies they reference (crates, pdfcraft, bun-tauri, cubeb-rs).

emulation.description: Emulation stack (docs/EMULATION.md): bun-engine, its in-tree cores, the headless ROM suite and the console matrix. Cargo needs every workspace member present, hence crates/* and the uutils and chipi-spec trees.

web.description: Bun workspaces (apps and packages), design system, fonts and the web vendor trees.

kernel-distro.description: Distribution and kernel sources (Linux only): pkgbuilds, kernels, Wine/Proton, LLVM.

vendor-minimal.description: Only the first-party crates; registry crates come from Cargo.lock.

all.description: Full checkout: disables sparse-checkout and initialises every non-optional submodule shallow.

ci.description: CI jobs (quality, rust, release plan): every first-party tree plus the vendor trees that Cargo path dependencies and the Bun workspaces need; the other ~165 vendor submodules (kernels, Wine, LLVM, CachyOS, ...) are skipped.

microsoft.description: Microsoft/Windows track: Fluent tokens and WinUI app, Microsoft app probes, the Windows facade, buncc and the Microsoft SDK sources.

themes.description: Themes track: @aphrody/themes and aphrody-themes (Material 3, Windows 11 Fluent, Apple Liquid Glass), the M3 token owners, Fluent tokens, craft-ui and the webos shell.
